sentences.en: The soul is made up of reason, determination, and passion.
sentences.zh: 1. 这个灵魂由理性、决心和激情组成。

sentences.en: He always shows great determination in everything he undertakes.
sentences.zh: 2. 他做任何事情都表现出极大的决心。

sentences.en: Working on puzzles has helped me gain focus, determination, and patience.
sentences.zh: 3. 做拼图游戏帮助我获得了专注力、决心和耐心。

senses.zh: 决心，坚定；决定，裁定；测定，确定；<法律>（财产权、利息的）终止
